note: WAEC Economics round 5 (R27 top-up): marginal utility and its diminishing law, consumer equilibrium; substitutes via cross elasticity, garri as inferior good, perishable supply inelastic; fixed costs, diminishing returns, increasing returns to scale, ATC formula; negative externality, street lighting as public good, free education as merit good; wage equilibrium, geographical mobility; store-of-value money, CPI, deflation; frictional vs structural unemployment; lender of last resort, banker to government, credit creation; output method, double counting, unpaid housework exclusion, real GDP; progressive vs regressive taxes, budget deficit, public debt; absolute advantage, terms of trade, reserves-financed BOP deficit; human capital, absolute poverty, optimum population. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Economics (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
